Qualify populated/empty native table-style packages, record-envelope move/remove/insert and valid native-donor replacement, exact language/spelling defaults, selected typed client-data reads and opaque-child CRUD.

verification_scope.table_style_reads: The text/table fixture has a version-zero 2393-byte embedded OPC package, with one tableStyles.xml part containing Medium Style 2 - Accent 1 and style ID 5C22544A-7EE6-4342-B048-85BDC9FD1C3A. Modern-media, fonts/math/handout and navigation fixtures have 1986-byte packages with empty style lists and the same default ID. All four atoms immediately precede EndDocument. The tests distinguish actual style content from an empty package.
verification_scope.table_style_operations: Move after EndDocument, exact no-op replacement/move, removal, reinsertion before EndDocument and replacement by the complete native donor package survive file save/reopen and live-persist discovery. Invalid envelopes, duplicate insertion and repeated removal retain exact typed refusals and staged work. These are record-envelope operations; effective style dependency validation and rendering are not established.
verification_scope.text_defaults: Four native decks store the exact ten-byte TextSIException payload 07 00 00 00 00 00 09 04 00 00: EN-US language 0409, alternate zero and false spelling flags. Full record serialization matches. All four contain nonempty slide text but no outline references or slide-list outline bodies. This qualifies default-field reads/serialization, not outline-body binding or language editing.
verification_scope.client_data_reads: The native title shape has Placeholder/ProgrammableTags/RoundTripShapeId12 in order, exact placeholder bytes, 58-byte tags and round-trip ID 2. Audio and OLE shapes expose external IDs 4 and 5 plus round-trip ID 3; navigation header/footer placeholders carry IDs 7, 9 and 8. The record snapshot round-trips exactly.
verification_scope.client_data_operations: Append, replace and remove an inert library-authored opaque child on the native title shape, preserving all original known children. Duplicate known-child insertion is InvalidValue and invalid removal is NotFound. No-op, save/reopen, forward/stale replay and inverse checks pass. The source archive remains immutable.
verification_scope.preservation: Every unedited live persisted record is byte-exact, including masters, notes, external storage and other slides. Table-style operations additionally compare every other Document child; client-data operations compare the full Document plus every other OfficeArt drawing record. All CFB streams except the Document/Current User publication streams remain exact, and the old Document stream remains a complete prefix. Patch inverse restores the complete original CFB archive.
verification_scope.picture_bullet_gap: All 11 binary PowerPoint fixtures, including the encrypted PPT opened with the recorded password, lack a live BlipCollection9 collection. Document binary tags contain neither collection nor entry records. Ten unencrypted packages refuse removal from the absent owner with UnsupportedTarget, accept empty reorder as no-op and retain exact bytes. Encrypted input remains read-only and to_bytes preserves the EncryptionPolicy refusal. This audit is not entered as positive picture-bullet coverage.
verification_scope.limits: No picture-bullet CRUD/dependency specimen, outline-body binding, full text-extension coverage, effective table-style resolution, opaque extension semantics, media/OLE execution, rendering or fresh native PowerPoint reopen is claimed. Donor style payloads and opaque client-data additions are library-produced derivatives.

specification_evidence.finding: The shape metadata owner is a recVer F, recType F011 container. Preservation checks treat that selected container as the one editable record while retaining every other OfficeArt record; existing ordered child grammar is unchanged by the error-classification fix.

The record contains an ECMA-376 table-style package; the native samples include both a populated style list and an empty default list. The test checks the real OPC payload while keeping the package edit scope limited to the record envelope.

The default special-information atom carries language/spelling metadata and excludes the extra paragraph/BiDi/smart-tag fields. The native mask and ten-byte payload are pinned without interpreting those defaults as an executed spelling policy.
